props.headline: About MyPoojaBooking™ -
props.subheadline: A trusted temple seva booking platform serving devotees across India and abroad.

props.title: Bridging Devotion and Technology
description: MyPoojaBooking™ (mypoojabooking.com) is an authorised online seva and pooja booking platform based in Mangaluru, Karnataka, India. Founded by Kochikar Technologies LLP, MyPoojaBookingserves as the official digital booking partner for participating temples, working directly with temple administrations rather than intermediaries, enabling devotees to book temple sevas, access festival calendars, and stay connected with their chosen temples from anywhere in the world.

Direct Temple Partnerships — Unlike marketplace-based pooja platforms, MyPoojaBooking works directly with temple administrations, ensuring every booking is recognised and processed through the temple's authorised systems. We leverage advanced cloud infrastructure to ensure that every ritual is authenticated, and every devotee can participate in seva regardless of where they are in the world.
props.quote: Where ancient tradition meets digital innovation.
